scope: Public minimal Webman 2.2.4 fixture without an AOT Composer plugin

doctorRepair.windows: private generation prepared and doctor healthy on the project
doctorRepair.macos: isolated installer upgraded, old mismatched compiler driver rejected, private generation repaired from 20 verified archives without redownload, doctor healthy

rootCauseResolved: The first packaged macOS CLI PHP lacked the filter extension present in the Windows TypePHP driver. Identical project inputs then produced different literal-string and persistent-function IDs. A separately locked macOS PHP 8.4.25 compiler driver with matching built-in extensions produced the identical Windows ELF SHA-256. The private CLI PHP remains separate for HTTPS and ZIP.

linuxRuntime.environment: isolated Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 QEMU guest on macOS arm64; not a bare-metal cloud host
linuxRuntime.transfer: product dist-aot archive copied to guest with matching SHA-256; macOS AppleDouble metadata excluded from clean replay

remaining: This does not prove SaiAdmin compilation or business behavior, ordinary PHP comparison, clean-user installer acceptance, or the four bare-metal target operating systems. The macOS CLI runtime still contains public upstream runner paths; the bounded normalization and installer require clean-user acceptance before release.
